principal_findings: 7,442 monthly/unknown rows across 16 source-genre frames; 465 study months, two UNKNOWN-date rows; 85 reproducible flags and 20 selected anomalies.
UK historic written answers: 135,689 independent parent IDs but 602 shared linked source objects; DEFRA policy: 1,019 parents, 3,023 objects and 2,008 attachment links.
US selected EPA/DOE metadata: 33,544 parent records with 18,590 saved content versions; EU frozen COM: 50,578 Works with 19,114 staged Item versions.
AU current catalogue: 821 candidate URLs, 819 without a main-table publication date; separately verified overlapping subset: five month/day originals and two year-only originals.
Calendar evidence supports several UK low months; UK 2013-05 official archive is partial and DEFRA 2013-04 has a dated policy-series concentration.
US 1994 selected-frame gaps, EU 1988-04 date concentration/recent COM lows and UK 2024-08 answer dates remain unresolved.
Long PDF/attachment texts inflate segment totals; the recorded UK format summary has 1,362 PDFs yielding 2,745,617 line/block segments, not independent parents.
limitations: Different committed source checkpoints; no synchronized pooled parent total.
Source-specific IDs and URLs are unique, but cross-source mirror/syndication equivalence is not fully resolved; title/date matches are only candidates.
Extracted-status columns are not new verification of readable historical text; saved body version is not necessarily the body as published on its original date.
No climate, affect, risk, anticipated-harm or fear labeling/interpretation was performed.
Figure PDFs passed text-size audit; automatic collision QA was unavailable because PyMuPDF is not installed.
